name: Allan's Hut
description: Also used as a stable for stalker's horses

name: Ben Alder Cottage
description: Ben Alder Cottage is in two parts. The old stone part of the bothy is always open and accessible for anyone to use. The timber built extension is for estate use only.

name: Burnmouth
description: Free Bothy with toilet, no electricity, no beds. Camping in the walled paddock is allowed.

name: Fords of Avon Refuge Hut
description: Not for planned overnight stays, merely a backup for very bad weather or (emergency) overnight stays

name: Leckie Bothy
description: An old shepards house previously converted to a bothy. Now locked and disused.

name: Sourlies
description: Can be very busy in the Summer, worth bring a tent.

name: Tighachrochadair
description: Sometimes fire-making supplies present.  Leave as you found it.  Guest book and info-board with history of croft.

name: Unnamed bothy
description: Sign: Emergency shelter for walkers and climbers
